# Contoso Correlation

Diagnostic views only. Source-supported loader/custom sampler proof is distinct from Azure live certification. Strict sampled-positive completeness and unsampled propagation remain mandatory. No row, screenshot or viewer-supplied metadata certifies origin. Missing data/unknown mappings remain To Do.

Filtered trace/business queries are not the all-table privacy scan. Export only R8-approved safe fields after scanning original intake.

typeSettings.validationMessage: Nonzero lowercase W3C trace ID required

    LinksText,Links,InvalidSpanMapping
| order by EventTime asc

let Spans=Records | where RecordKind=="span";
let Index=union
    (Spans | where isnotempty(SpanId) | project TargetTrace=TraceId,TargetSpan=SpanId),
    (Records | where RecordKind=="view" and isnotempty(ViewId) | project TargetTrace=TraceId,TargetSpan=ViewId)
| distinct TargetTrace,TargetSpan;
let Parents=Spans
| where EventTime>=windowStart
| extend TargetTrace=TraceId,TargetSpan=ParentSpanId,Relation="parent"
| join kind=leftanti Index on TargetTrace,TargetSpan;
let LinkIndex=Spans | where isnotempty(SpanId) | project TargetTrace=TraceId,TargetSpan=SpanId | distinct TargetTrace,TargetSpan;
let MissingLinks=Spans
| where EventTime>=windowStart and array_length(Links)>0
| mv-expand Link=Links
| extend TargetTrace=tostring(Link.operation_Id),TargetSpan=tostring(Link.id),Relation="link"
| join kind=leftanti LinkIndex on TargetTrace,TargetSpan;
let BadLinks=Spans
| where EventTime>=windowStart and isnotempty(LinksText) and isnull(array_length(Links))
| extend TargetTrace=TraceId,TargetSpan="",Relation="link-format";
union Parents,MissingLinks,BadLinks
| project EventTime,IngestedAt,DurationMs,ChildTrace=TraceId,ChildSpan=SpanId,
    TargetTrace,TargetSpan,Relation,RoleName,RawId,RawParentId,InvalidSpanMapping
| join kind=leftouter BoundaryAssignments on $left.ChildTrace==$right.AssignedTrace,$left.ChildSpan==$right.AssignedSpan
| join kind=leftouter BoundaryMap on BoundaryId
| join kind=leftouter ReferenceProofs on ChildTrace,ChildSpan,TargetTrace,TargetSpan,Relation
| extend EndTime=EventTime+DurationMs*1ms,
    InvalidReference=InvalidSpanMapping or Relation=="link-format"
        or not(TargetTrace matches regex "^[a-f0-9]{32}$") or TargetTrace=="00000000000000000000000000000000"
        or (Relation=="link" and isempty(TargetSpan))
        or (isnotempty(TargetSpan) and (not(TargetSpan matches regex "^[a-f0-9]{16}$") or TargetSpan=="0000000000000000"))
| extend Classification=case(InvalidReference,"defect",
    isempty(TargetSpan) and Relation=="parent" and ParentMode=="root" and isnotempty(AssignmentEvidence),"expected-root",
    isnotempty(ReferenceEvidence),ProvenClass,
    isnull(IngestedAt) or isnull(EndTime) or IngestedAt>queryTime-grace or EndTime>queryTime-grace,"delayed",
    "defect")
| extend GateAction=case(Classification in ("expected-root","expected-remote"),"declared-boundary",
    Classification=="delayed","requery-before-deadline",
    Classification in ("cross-resource","sampled","outside-window","outside-retention"),"required-coverage-not-waived",
    "fail-until-adjudicated"),IsProvenApplicationDefect=false
| project EventTime,EndTime,IngestedAt,ChildTrace,ChildSpan,TargetTrace,TargetSpan,Relation,
    BoundaryId,RoleName,Classification,GateAction,IsProvenApplicationDefect,
    AssignmentEvidence,ReferenceEvidence,RawId,RawParentId
| order by Classification asc,EventTime asc

## Boundary triage input contract

The compiled declared boundaries below are generated solely from `contracts\expected-boundary-map.v1.json`. Actual observed trace/span assignments and reference evidence must be bound by the reviewed R9 capture/renderer; this default viewer does not invent them. Empty assignments cannot produce a green certificate. Composite ID mapping must be source/role proven before the assertion pipeline accepts it.

Use the R7 query renderer with the sealed run inputs for final candidate results; select the actual Application Insights resource for Application Map and Transaction Diagnostics. Their real screenshots remain required live assets.

content.query:
union AppRequests,AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId =~ "{ApplicationInsights:escapejson}"
| extend ObservedIngestion=ingestion_time(),EndTime=TimeGenerated+DurationMs*1ms
| where isnotnull(ObservedIngestion)
| extend DelaySeconds=(ObservedIngestion-EndTime)/1s
| summarize PhysicalSpans=count(),P95=percentile(DelaySeconds,95),P99=percentile(DelaySeconds,99) by AppRoleName

union AppRequests,AppDependencies,AppTraces,AppExceptions,AppEvents,AppPageViews
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId =~ "{ApplicationInsights:escapejson}" and _IsBillable =~ "true"
| summarize PhysicalRows=count(),BillableBytes=sum(_BilledSize) by Type,AppRoleName
| extend BillableGB=BillableBytes/1000000000.0

Usage
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and IsBillable
| summarize BillableGB=sum(Quantity)/1000.0 by DataType,bin(StartTime,1h)
| order by StartTime asc

_LogOperation
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Level in ("Warning","Error")
| project TimeGenerated,Category,Operation,Level

## Profiles, load and cost

The bounded controller records desired/observed hashes, all-layer expiry/restore and independent-watchdog status. Missing acknowledgements/reset block PASS. Actual CPU/memory/native URL privacy/ingestion scope require measured supported metrics, not zeros.

Approved OBS-04/15 load: 10 requests/s for 120 seconds; p95 ≤1000 ms, p99 ≤2500 ms; unexpected errors ≤1%; CPU mean ≤70%, peak ≤90%; memory ≤80% limit; instrumentation p95 overhead ≤20%; no missing declared certification spans. Fault vectors are separate.

Cost uses approved R1 price/budget input, physical billed sizes and actual variable meters. `ItemCount` never multiplies billed bytes. Caps can overshoot and blind ingestion, Usage is hourly/delayed, and budgets do not stop resources. Target is 1000 USD/day, intended lifetime 720 hours; this page is not an invoice or a provisioning approval.
